text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Black V-neck sweater with red gray argyle diamond motif over white inner shirt, dark straight jeans tucked into black tall lace-up boots.
original_prompt: Create one photorealistic wardrobe catalog product image. Pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light, true fabric texture, portrait 2:3. No human, face, hair, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, stand or hanger. Entire object fully inside frame with generous margins. No added text, labels, watermark, border or scenery. Input image is a clothing design reference. Use ONLY the outfit at 从左第2位; ignore every other outfit. Generate one coherent EMPTY hollow garment ensemble front-facing in a neutral symmetrical stance, sleeves empty. Preserve the clothing cuts and colors: Black V-neck sweater with red gray argyle diamond motif over white inner shirt, dark straight jeans tucked into black tall lace-up boots. Remove ALL detachable accessories including bags, hats, belts, neckties, jewelry, eyeglasses, scarves and chains. Keep sewn garment ties, attached buckle panels and integral collars. Keep shoes and socks. Exclude phones, umbrellas, drinks, books and all handheld props. No collage or alternative outfits.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
